summary: With the gaps closed I spent this turn settling how far the verification finding actually reaches, since that is the boundary a reader needs to judge it. Reading the consumers answers it: a verify future is constructed only in the public VerifyLeader, and every other reference in the package either registers the future on the leader or answers it with not-leader in the follower and candidate loops, with no other in-tree path creating one. The exposure is therefore confined to that single API and to applications that use it as a read guard; commitment, elections and the leader-lease check are outside it, and each of those computes over voters, which is exactly why they are unaffected while the verification is not. I recorded that as a narrowing of the saved behaviour's conditions on its existing id with a changed premise that says plainly what moved - the mechanism is unchanged and only its reach is now stated, from topologies where it can be reached to the single producer it can arise through - and added the source range for the producer so the claim is anchored. No execution was spent on it, because it is decidable by reading and the remaining budget would not have produced a receipt I could interpret. The run's substantive record is unchanged and complete on what it established: six behaviours witnessed with receipts, including the durable term regression reproduced twice with its causal control and bounded by two uninstrumented probes whose zero results are explained by application order at the shared store key rather than by latency; the protocol-gate bypass on the heartbeat fast path; the verification count drawing on sources outside the voter set, now scoped to one API; the unanswered-heartbeat case with its transport-dependent release; the scoped log-cache negative; and the knowledge corrections that record where earlier phrasing over- or under-stated what the evidence supported.
